description: This file defines a React functional component named CartPage, which displays the user's shopping cart. It interfaces with CartContext to retrieve and manipulate cart data, and uses react-router-dom for navigation. The component renders cart items, total price, and provides options to update item quantities, remove items, clear the cart, or proceed to checkout.

methods.name: CartPage()
methods.description: React functional component rendering the shopping cart page, managing cart display and interactions.
